newsitem.title: UK: European veg oils track lower Chicago at close.
newsitem.headline: European veg oils track lower Chicago at close.

text.p: Most sectors of the European vegetable oil market closed lower on Monday following further falls in Chicago futures at the opening.
"Buyers and sellers are miles apart, we could have all gone home early," said one trader.
Earlier data released by two Malaysian cargo surveyors had little impact on the palm oil market.
Societe Generale de Surveillance put local palm oil exports during November at 700,566 tonnes while Caleb Brett put the figure at 673,905 tonnes.
The official Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority figure for October was 727,629 tonnes.
Crude palm oil cif Europe closed $2.50 down to $2.50 up after Dec traded at $565 a tonne cif.
Refined palm oil finished unchanged to $2.50 lower after Dec RBD palm oil traded at $517.50 and Dec olein fetched $556, $557.50 and $555 a tonne fob Malaysian ports.
Palm stearin close $2.50 up after trading at $372.50 for Dec.
Coconut oil was mixed with sellers $5 down to $5 up after Jan/Mar traded at $765 a tonne cif.
Palmkernel oil was also mixed and closed with offers $5 each way.
Soft oils drifted lower during the afternoon owing to a lack of buyers and lower Chicago futures.
Soyoil closed 0.50 to 1.50 guilders down after Jan traded at 88 guilders a 100 kilos fob ex-mill.
Rape oil finished 0.75 to 1.25 guilders lower.
Based on sellers' prices, the premium for rape oil over soyoil was three to five guilders at the close against 3.75 to 5.25 guilders on Friday.
